schedule-demo:
; Step with alternating feet, left before right
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"left","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"left":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"left\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(relation left (i64))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"right","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"right":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"right\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(relation right (i64))

(left 0)
(right 0)

(ruleset step-left)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"schedule-demo/rule-001","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_left_0_0","body/1/expr/0":"match_right_1_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_left_0_0"}}}
(rule ((left x) (right x))
      ((left (+ x 1)))
      :ruleset step-left)

(ruleset step-right)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"schedule-demo/rule-002","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","y":"y"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_left_0_0","body/1/expr/0":"match_right_1_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_right_0_0"}}}
(rule ((left x) (right y) (= x (+ y 1)))
      ((right x))
      :ruleset step-right)

(run-schedule
      (repeat 10
            (saturate step-right)
            (saturate step-left)))

; We took 10 steps with the left, but the right couldn't go the first round,
; so we took only 9 steps with the right.
(check (left 10))
(check (right 9))
(fail (check (left 11)))
(fail (check (right 10)))
eqsat-basic:
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"Math","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Num":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Var":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Add":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} + {right}","precedence":50},"Mul":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} * {right}","precedence":60}}}
(datatype Math
  (Num i64)
  (Var String)
  (Add Math Math)
  (Mul Math Math))

;; expr1 = 2 * (x + 3)
(let $expr1 (Mul (Num 2) (Add (Var "x") (Num 3))))
;; expr2 = 6 + 2 * x
(let $expr2 (Add (Num 6) (Mul (Num 2) (Var "x"))))


;; (rule ((= __root (Add a b)))
;;       ((union __root (Add b a)))
(rewrite (Add a b)
         (Add b a))
(rewrite (Mul a (Add b c))
         (Add (Mul a b) (Mul a c)))
(rewrite (Add (Num a) (Num b))
         (Num (+ a b)))
(rewrite (Mul (Num a) (Num b))
         (Num (* a b)))

(run 10)
(check (= $expr1 $expr2))
eqsolve:
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"Expr","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Add":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} + {right}","precedence":50},"Neg":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Neg\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Num":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Mul":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} * {right}","precedence":60},"Var":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100}}}
(datatype Expr
  (Add Expr Expr)
  (Neg Expr)
  (Num i64)
  (Mul Expr Expr)
  (Var String)
)

(rewrite (Add x y) (Add y x))
(rewrite (Add (Add x y) z) (Add x (Add y z)))
(rewrite (Add (Num x) (Num y)) (Num (+ x y)))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsolve/rule-004","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","y":"y","z":"z"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_Add_0_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_Add_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= (Add x y) z))
      ((union (Add z (Neg y)) x)))
(rewrite (Neg (Neg x)) x)
(rewrite (Neg (Num n)) (Num (- 0 n)))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsolve/rule-007","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","v":"v"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Var_0_1","head/0/expr/0":"result_Mul_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= x (Var v))) ((union (Mul (Num 1) x) x)))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsolve/rule-008","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","x1":"x1","x2":"x2"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Add_0_1","head/0/expr/0":"result_Mul_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= x (Add x1 x2))) ((union (Mul (Num 1) x) x)))
(rewrite (Add (Mul y x) (Mul z x)) (Mul (Add y z) x))
(rewrite (Mul x y) (Mul y x))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsolve/rule-011","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","y":"y","z":"z"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_Mul_0_0","body/0/expr/1":"match_Num_0_1","head/0/expr/1":"result_Num_0_1"}}}
(rule ((= (Mul (Num x) y) (Num z))
       (= (% z x) 0))
      ((union y (Num (/ z x)))))

; system 1: x + 2 = 7
(union (Add (Var "x") (Num 2)) (Num 7))
; system 2: z + y = 6, 2z = y
(union (Add (Var "z") (Var "y")) (Num 6))
(union (Add (Var "z") (Var "z")) (Var "y"))

(run 5)
(extract (Var "x"))
(extract (Var "y"))
(extract (Var "z"))
(check (= (Var "z") (Add (Num 6) (Neg (Var "y")))))
(check (= (Var "y") (Add (Add (Num 6) (Neg (Var "y"))) (Add (Num 6) (Neg (Var "y"))))))
(check (= (Var "y") (Add (Add (Num 12) (Neg (Var "y"))) (Neg (Var "y")))))
(check (= (Add (Var "y") (Var "y")) 
          (Add (Num 12) (Neg (Var "y")))))
(check (= (Add (Add (Var "y") (Var "y")) (Var "y"))
          (Num 12)))
(check (= (Add (Mul (Num 2) (Var "y")) (Var "y"))
          (Num 12)))
(check (= (Mul (Num 3) (Var "y"))
          (Num 12)))

herbie:
;; Implements part of the simplification layer of herbie in egglog🫡

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;;
;; Datatypes

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"Math","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Num":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Var":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Const":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Unary":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"Unary\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90},"Add":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} + {right}","precedence":50},"Sub":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} - {right}","precedence":50},"Mul":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} * {right}","precedence":60},"Div":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"frac({left}, {right})","precedence":60},"Pow":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left}^({right})","precedence":80},"Neg":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Neg\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Sqrt":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"sqrt({value})","precedence":90},"Cbrt":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Cbrt\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Fabs":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Fabs\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Ceil":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Ceil\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Floor":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Floor\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Round":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Round\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Log":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Log\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype Math
  ; Ground terms
  (Num BigRat)
  (Var String)

  ; Custom ops
  (Const String)
  (Unary String Math)
  ; unneeded for now
  ; (Binary String Math Math)

  ; Constant-folding ops
  (Add Math Math)
  (Sub Math Math)
  (Mul Math Math)
  (Div Math Math)
  (Pow Math Math)
  (Neg Math)
  (Sqrt Math)
  (Cbrt Math) ; cube root
  (Fabs Math)
  (Ceil Math)
  (Floor Math)
  (Round Math)
  (Log Math))

(let $r-zero (bigrat (bigint 0) (bigint 1)))
(let $r-one  (bigrat (bigint 1) (bigint 1)))
(let $r-two  (bigrat (bigint 2) (bigint 1)))
(let $zero (Num $r-zero))
(let $one  (Num $r-one))
(let $two  (Num $r-two))
(let $three (Num (bigrat (bigint 3) (bigint 1))))
(let $neg-one (Neg $one))

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;;
;; Analyses
;; --------
;; This example has three analyses:
;; an interval analysis consisting of a hi and lo component
;; and a non-zero analysis.
;; The non-zero analysis is built off the interval analysis (in order to prove
;; that rewrites are sound, even if some parts of an expr can't be const-evaled)

; TODO: unbounded intervals?
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"hi","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"hi":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"hi\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(function hi (Math) BigRat :merge (min old new))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"lo","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"lo":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"lo\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(function lo (Math) BigRat :merge (max old new))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"non-zero","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"non_zero":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"non-zero\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(relation non-zero (Math))

;; First, constant folding!
;; We don't need an explicit constant folding analysis, we can just union
;; with nums when we can

; Cases
(rewrite (Add (Num a) (Num b)) (Num (+ a b)))
(rewrite (Sub (Num a) (Num b)) (Num (- a b)))
(rewrite (Mul (Num a) (Num b)) (Num (* a b)))
(rewrite (Div (Num a) denom) (Num (/ a b)) :when ((= denom (Num b)) (non-zero denom)))
(rewrite (Pow (Num a) (Num b)) (Num res) :when ((= res (pow a b))))
(rewrite (Neg (Num a)) (Num (neg a)))
;; TODO unimplemented
;; (rewrite (Sqrt (Num a)) (Num res) :when ((= res (sqrt a))))
;; (rewrite (Cbrt (Num a)) (Num res) :when ((= res (cbrt a))))
(rewrite (Fabs (Num a)) (Num (abs a)))
(rewrite (Ceil (Num a)) (Num (ceil a)))
(rewrite (Floor (Num a)) (Num (floor a)))
(rewrite (Round (Num a)) (Num (round a)))
(rewrite (Log (Num a)) (Num res) :when ((= res (log a))))

;; To check if something is zero, we check that zero is not contained in the
;; interval. There are two possible (overlapping!) cases:
;; - There exists a lo interval, in which case it must be larger than 0
;; - There exists a hi interval, in which case it must be smaller than 0
;; This assumes that intervals are well-formed: lo <= hi at all times.
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-012","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"l":"l","e":"e"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_lo_0_1","head/0/expr/0":"result_non-zero_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= l (lo e))
       (> l $r-zero))
      ((non-zero e)))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-013","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"h":"h","e":"e"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_hi_0_1","head/0/expr/0":"result_non-zero_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= h (hi e))
       (< h $r-zero))
      ((non-zero e)))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-014","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","ve":"ve"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Num_0_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Num ve)))
      ((set (lo e) ve)
       (set (hi e) ve)))

;; The interval analyses are similar to the constant-folding analysis,
;; except we have to take the lower/upper bound of the results we get
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-015","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","b":"b","la":"la","lb":"lb"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Add_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1","body/2/expr/1":"match_lo_2_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Add a b))
       (= la (lo a))
       (= lb (lo b)))
      ((set (lo e) (+ la lb))))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-016","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","b":"b","ha":"ha","hb":"hb"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Add_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_hi_1_1","body/2/expr/1":"match_hi_2_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Add a b))
       (= ha (hi a))
       (= hb (hi b)))
      ((set (hi e) (+ ha hb))))
      
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-017","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","b":"b","la":"la","ha":"ha","lb":"lb","hb":"hb"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Sub_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1","body/2/expr/1":"match_hi_2_1","body/3/expr/1":"match_lo_3_1","body/4/expr/1":"match_hi_4_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Sub a b))
       (= la (lo a))
       (= ha (hi a))
       (= lb (lo b))
       (= hb (hi b)))
      ((set (lo e) 
          (min (min (- la lb) (- la hb))
               (min (- ha lb) (- ha hb))))
       (set (hi e) 
          (max (max (- la lb) (- la hb))
               (max (- ha lb) (- ha hb))))))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-018","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","b":"b","la":"la","ha":"ha","lb":"lb","hb":"hb"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Mul_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1","body/2/expr/1":"match_hi_2_1","body/3/expr/1":"match_lo_3_1","body/4/expr/1":"match_hi_4_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Mul a b))
       (= la (lo a))
       (= ha (hi a))
       (= lb (lo b))
       (= hb (hi b)))
      ((set (lo e) 
          (min (min (* la lb) (* la hb))
               (min (* ha lb) (* ha hb))))
       (set (hi e) 
          (max (max (* la lb) (* la hb))
               (max (* ha lb) (* ha hb))))))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-019","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","b":"b","la":"la","ha":"ha","lb":"lb","hb":"hb"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Div_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1","body/2/expr/1":"match_hi_2_1","body/3/expr/1":"match_lo_3_1","body/4/expr/1":"match_hi_4_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Div a b))
       (= la (lo a))
       (= ha (hi a))
       (= lb (lo b))
       (= hb (hi b)))
      ((set (lo e) 
          (min (min (/ la lb) (/ la hb))
               (min (/ ha lb) (/ ha hb))))
       (set (hi e) 
          (max (max (/ la lb) (/ la hb))
               (max (/ ha lb) (/ ha hb))))))

; TODO: Pow

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-020","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","la":"la","ha":"ha"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Neg_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1","body/2/expr/1":"match_hi_2_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Neg a))
       (= la (lo a))
       (= ha (hi a)))
      ((set (lo e) (neg ha))
       (set (hi e) (neg la))))

; TODO: Sqrt
; TODO: Cbrt

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-021","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","la":"la","ha":"ha"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Fabs_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1","body/2/expr/1":"match_hi_2_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Fabs a))
       (= la (lo a))
       (= ha (hi a)))
      ((set (lo e) (min (abs la) (abs ha)))
       (set (hi e) (max (abs la) (abs ha)))))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-022","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","la":"la"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Ceil_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Ceil a))
       (= la (lo a)))
      ((set (lo e) (ceil la))))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-023","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","ha":"ha"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Ceil_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_hi_1_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Ceil a))
       (= ha (hi a)))
      ((set (hi e) (ceil ha))))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-024","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","la":"la"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Floor_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Floor a))
       (= la (lo a)))
      ((set (lo e) (floor la))))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-025","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","ha":"ha"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Floor_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_hi_1_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Floor a))
       (= ha (hi a)))
      ((set (hi e) (floor ha))))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-026","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","la":"la"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Round_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_lo_1_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Round a))
       (= la (lo a)))
      ((set (lo e) (round la))))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"herbie/rule-027","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","a":"a","ha":"ha"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Round_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_hi_1_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Round a))
       (= ha (hi a)))
      ((set (hi e) (round ha))))

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;;
;; Rewrites
;; --------
;; These rewrites were compiled from src/syntax/rules.rkt in the herbie repo,
;; using all rewrites in the `simplify` rewrite group.

;; Commutativity
(rewrite (Add a b) (Add b a))
(rewrite (Mul a b) (Mul b a))

;; Associativity
(rewrite (Add a (Add b c)) (Add (Add a b) c))
(rewrite (Add (Add a b) c) (Add a (Add b c)))
(rewrite (Add a (Sub b c)) (Sub (Add a b) c))
(rewrite (Add (Sub a b) c) (Sub a (Sub b c)))
(rewrite (Sub a (Add b c)) (Sub (Sub a b) c))
(rewrite (Sub (Add a b) c) (Add a (Sub b c)))

;; move from first stack
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"towers-of-hanoi/rule-001","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"len":"len","x":"x","a":"a","b":"b","c":"c"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Config_0_1"}}}

      ((set (Config a (Cons x b) c) (+ len 1))

bdd:
; Binary Decision Diagrams are if-then-else trees/ compressed tries that hash cons their leaves
; This is easily expressible in the facilities provided. Everything in egglog is automatcally shared
; and Compression is easily expressible as a rule.

; They are a notion of first class set useful for certain classes of uniformly describable sets.
; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Binary_decision_diagram
; https://www.lri.fr/~filliatr/ftp/publis/hash-consing2.pdf Type-Safe Modular Hash-Consing - Section 3.3

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"BDD","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"ITE":{"fields":["arg0","arg1","arg2"],"typst":"upright(\"ITE\")({arg0}, {arg1}, {arg2})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype BDD
    (ITE i64 BDD BDD) ; variables labelled by number
)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"TrueConst","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"TrueConst":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"TrueConst\")","precedence":90}}}
(constructor TrueConst () BDD)
(let $True (TrueConst))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"FalseConst","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"FalseConst":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"FalseConst\")","precedence":90}}}
(constructor FalseConst () BDD)
(let $False (FalseConst))

; compress unneeded nodes
(rewrite (ITE n a a) a)

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"bddand","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"bddand":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"bddand\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor bddand (BDD BDD) BDD)
(rewrite (bddand x y) (bddand y x))
(rewrite (bddand $False n) $False)
(rewrite (bddand $True x) x)

; We use an order where low variables are higher in tree
; Could go the other way.
(rewrite (bddand (ITE n a1 a2) (ITE m b1 b2))
    (ITE n (bddand a1 (ITE m b1 b2)) (bddand a2 (ITE m b1 b2)))
    :when ((< n m))
)
(rewrite (bddand (ITE n a1 a2) (ITE n b1 b2))
    (ITE n (bddand a1 b1) (bddand a2 b2))
)

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"bddor","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"bddor":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"bddor\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor bddor (BDD BDD) BDD)
(rewrite (bddor x y) (bddor y x))
(rewrite (bddor $True n) $True)
(rewrite (bddor $False x) x)
(rewrite (bddor (ITE n a1 a2) (ITE m b1 b2))
    (ITE n (bddor a1 (ITE m b1 b2)) (bddor a2 (ITE m b1 b2)))
    :when ((< n m))
)
(rewrite (bddor (ITE n a1 a2) (ITE n b1 b2))
    (ITE n (bddor a1 b1) (bddor a2 b2))
)

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"bddnot","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"bddnot":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"bddnot\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor bddnot (BDD) BDD)
(rewrite (bddnot $True) $False)
(rewrite (bddnot $False) $True)
(rewrite (bddnot (ITE n a1 a2)) (ITE n (bddnot a1) (bddnot a2)))


; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"bddxor","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"bddxor":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"bddxor\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor bddxor (BDD BDD) BDD)
(rewrite (bddxor x y) (bddxor y x))
(rewrite (bddxor $True n) (bddnot n))
(rewrite (bddxor $False x) x)

(rewrite (bddxor (ITE n a1 a2) (ITE m b1 b2))
    (ITE n (bddxor a1 (ITE m b1 b2)) (bddxor a2 (ITE m b1 b2)))
    :when ((< n m))
)
(rewrite (bddxor (ITE n a1 a2) (ITE n b1 b2))
    (ITE n (bddxor a1 b1) (bddxor a2 b2))
)

(sort Maths2Multiset (MultiSet Math2))

        (multiset-of (FromMath (Num 1)) (FromMath (Num 2)) (FromMath (Num 3)))

        (multiset-sum (multiset-of (Num 1) (Num 2) (Num 3)) (multiset-of (Num 1) (Num 2) (Num 4)))

; flat-map
(push)

;; Verify multiset of multiset
(push)
(sort Mathss (MultiSet Maths))
(let $xx (multiset-of (multiset-of (Num 1) (Num 2) (Num 3)) (multiset-of (Num 1) (Num 2) (Num 3))))
(union (Num 1) (Num 2))
(check (= $xx (multiset-of (multiset-of (Num 2) (Num 2) (Num 3)) (multiset-of (Num 2) (Num 2) (Num 3)))))

;; Verify unstable multiset fill index and counting

(union (Num 1) (Num 2))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"product","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"product":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"product\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}

(let $aa (Num 100))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"ms-count","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"ms_count":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"ms-count\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}
(function ms-count (Maths Math) i64 :merge (+ old new))
(sort MSIndexFn (UnstableFn (Maths Math) i64))
; Fill index tables for products. The rule body matches a row in the
; `product` table, so each `(product …)` eclass should fire the rule
; once. `:naive` keeps it that way: under seminaive, canonicalization
; after a later union would re-fire the rule on the same row and
; double-count via `ms-count`'s `+ old new` merge.
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"multiset/rule-002","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"outer":"outer","inner":"inner"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_product_0_1"}}}
(rule
    ((= outer (product inner)))
    ((unstable-multiset-fill-index inner (unstable-fn "ms-count")))
    :naive)
(run 10)
(check (= 2 (ms-count $xs (Num 1))))
; Verify stays the same even if unioned and run again
(union $zz $aa)
(run 10)
(check (= 2 (ms-count $xs (Num 1))))
; Verify updates properly after unioning child
(union (Num 1) (Num 3))
(check (= 3 (ms-count $xs (Num 1))))

;; check clear index
(unstable-multiset-clear-index  $xs (unstable-fn "ms-count"))
(fail (ms-count $xs (Num 1)))

(pop)

;; union values should union all items inside
(push)
(multiset-union-values $xs)
(check (= (Num 1) (Num 2)))
(pop)

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"add","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"add":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"add\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}

;; Bind the reduce results at top level (`Full` context, so the wrapped
;; `add` constructor may mint), then `check` against the bindings.
;; `unstable-multiset-reduce` inside `check` would be `Read` context,
;; where constructors are inadmissible (no-mint constructors are banned).
(let $sum-xs (unstable-multiset-reduce (unstable-fn "add") (Num 0) $xs))
(check (= $sum-xs (add (add (Num 1) (Num 2)) (Num 3))))
(let $sum-empty (unstable-multiset-reduce (unstable-fn "add") (Num 0) (multiset-of)))
(check (= $sum-empty (Num 0)))
(pop)

;; filter
(push)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"is-even","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"is_even":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"is-even\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}

(sort IsEvenFn (UnstableFn (Math) Unit))
(check (=
    (unstable-multiset-filter (unstable-fn "is-even") $xs)
    (multiset-of (Num 2))))
(check (=
    (unstable-multiset-filter-not (unstable-fn "is-even") $xs)
    (multiset-of (Num 1) (Num 3))))

(pop)

prims:
; A nasty, imperative implementation of Prim's algorithm... in egglog!
; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prim%27s_algorithm

; Weighted edge (vertex 1 * vertex 2 * weight)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"edge","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Edge":{"fields":["arg0","arg1","arg2"],"typst":"upright(\"Edge\")({arg0}, {arg1}, {arg2})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype edge (Edge i64 i64 i64))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"edge-exists","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"edge_exists":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"edge-exists\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(relation edge-exists (edge))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"mytrue","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"mytrue":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"mytrue\")","precedence":90}}}
(relation mytrue ())
(mytrue)
(let $infinity 99999999)  ; close enough

; ==== PROBLEM INSTANCES ====

; Graph 1
; (1)--2--(2)
;    \     |
;      1   2
;        \ |
; (3)--3--(4)
(ruleset graph1)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-001","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_mytrue_0_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_0_0","head/1/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_1_0","head/2/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_2_0","head/3/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_3_0"}}}
(rule ((mytrue))
      ((edge-exists (Edge 1 2 2))
       (edge-exists (Edge 1 4 1))
       (edge-exists (Edge 2 4 2))
       (edge-exists (Edge 3 4 3)))
       :ruleset graph1)

; Graph 2
; (1)-2-(2)  (3)
;  |\   /|   / |
;  | 3 5 |  4  |
;  5  X  2 /   5
;  | / \ |/    |
; (4)-4-(5)-7-(6)
(ruleset graph2)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-002","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_mytrue_0_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_0_0","head/1/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_1_0","head/2/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_2_0","head/3/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_3_0","head/4/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_4_0","head/5/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_5_0","head/6/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_6_0","head/7/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_7_0","head/8/expr/0":"result_edge-exists_8_0"}}}
(rule ((mytrue))
      ((edge-exists (Edge 1 2 1))
       (edge-exists (Edge 1 4 5))
       (edge-exists (Edge 1 5 3))
       (edge-exists (Edge 2 4 5))
       (edge-exists (Edge 2 5 2))
       (edge-exists (Edge 3 5 4))
       (edge-exists (Edge 3 6 5))
       (edge-exists (Edge 4 5 4))
       (edge-exists (Edge 5 6 7)))
       :ruleset graph2)

; ==== "INIT" RULESET ====

(ruleset init)

; Graph is undirected
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-003","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"e":"e","x":"x","y":"y","weight":"weight"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Edge_0_1","head/0/expr/1":"result_Edge_0_1"}}}
(rule ((= e (Edge x y weight)))
      ((union e (Edge y x weight)))
      :ruleset init)

; Whether a vertex is included *so far* (this changes). Returns 0 or 1.
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"vertex-included","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"vertex_included":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"vertex-included\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(function vertex-included (i64) i64 :merge (max old new))

; All vertices default to being not included (note vertex-included's :merge)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-004","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","y":"y","weight":"weight"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_edge-exists_0_0"}}}
(rule ((edge-exists (Edge x y weight)))
      ((set (vertex-included x) 0))
      :ruleset init)

; Keep track of the current iteration
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"current-iteration","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"current_iteration":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"current-iteration\")","precedence":90}}}
(function current-iteration () i64 :merge (max old new))

; Map iteration to best edge found so far
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"iteration-to-best-edge","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"iteration_to_best_edge":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"iteration-to-best-edge\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(function iteration-to-best-edge (i64) edge :merge new)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"iteration-to-best-edge-weight","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"iteration_to_best_edge_weight":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"iteration-to-best-edge-weight\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(function iteration-to-best-edge-weight (i64) i64 :merge new)

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-005","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_mytrue_0_0"}}}
(rule ((mytrue))
      ((set (vertex-included 1) 1)  ; Initially just include vertex 1
       (set (current-iteration) 0)
       (set (iteration-to-best-edge-weight 0) $infinity))
      :ruleset init)

; === "CHOOSE BEST EDGE" RULESET ===

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"edge-in-mst","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"edge_in_mst":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"edge-in-mst\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(relation edge-in-mst (edge))  ; whether an edge is in our solution

(ruleset choose-best-edge)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-006","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"i":"i","x":"x","y":"y","weight":"weight"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_current-iteration_0_1","body/1/expr/0":"match_edge-exists_1_0","body/2/expr/1":"match_vertex-included_2_1","body/3/expr/1":"match_vertex-included_3_1"}}}
(rule ((= i (current-iteration))
       (edge-exists (Edge x y weight))
       (= 1 (vertex-included x))
       (= 0 (vertex-included y))
       (< weight (iteration-to-best-edge-weight i)))
      ((set (iteration-to-best-edge-weight i) weight)
       (set (iteration-to-best-edge i) (Edge x y weight)))
      :ruleset choose-best-edge)

; === "FINISH ITERATION" RULESET ===

(ruleset finish-iteration)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-007","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"i":"i","x":"x","y":"y","weight":"weight"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_current-iteration_0_1","body/1/expr/0":"match_Edge_1_0","body/1/expr/1":"match_iteration-to-best-edge_1_1","head/0/expr/0":"result_edge-in-mst_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= i (current-iteration))
       (= (Edge x y weight) (iteration-to-best-edge i)))
      ((edge-in-mst (Edge x y weight))    ; incorporate chosen best edge
       (set (vertex-included x) 1)        ; mark its vertices as included
       (set (vertex-included y) 1)
       (set (current-iteration) (+ i 1))  ; advance iteration
       (set (iteration-to-best-edge-weight (+ i 1)) $infinity))
      :ruleset finish-iteration)

; === RUN VIA SCHEDULE ===

(run-schedule
    (saturate init graph1)  ; change to graph2 to see other example
    (saturate (saturate choose-best-edge) finish-iteration)
)

; === PRINT RESULTS ===

; (print-function edge-in-mst) ; this is not very helpful

; Just copy canonical edges to solution
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"solution","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"solution":{"fields":["arg0","arg1","arg2"],"typst":"upright(\"solution\")({arg0}, {arg1}, {arg2})","precedence":90}}}
(relation solution (i64 i64 i64))

(ruleset finalize)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"prims/rule-008","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","y":"y","weight":"weight"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_edge-in-mst_0_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_solution_0_0"}}}
(rule ((edge-in-mst (Edge x y weight)) (< x y))
      ((solution x y weight))
      :ruleset finalize)
(run-schedule (saturate finalize))

(print-function solution 100) ; this is better

;; Let's pretend that we are optimizing mathematical expressions, but for some reason on our compiler
;; multiplying by three is very expensive. So we want to rewrite those forms to three additions instead, and always
;; extract that form.

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"Math","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Num":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Var":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Add":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} + {right}","precedence":50},"Mul":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} * {right}","precedence":60}}}
(datatype Math
  (Num i64)
  (Var String)
  (Add Math Math)
  (Mul Math Math))


(rewrite (Mul (Num 3) x) (Add x (Add x x)) :subsume)

(let $x (Mul (Num 2) (Mul (Num 3) (Var "x"))))

(run 10)

; When X is extracted, we get the optimized form, where the * 3 is expanded out
(check (= $x (Mul (Num 2) (Add (Var "x") (Add (Var "x") (Var "x"))))))
(extract $x)
; Will be (Mul (Num 2) (Add (Var "x") (Add (Var "x") (Var "x"))))

; Even though it can't be extracted, we can still check that $x equal 2 * (3 * $x)
(check (= $x (Mul (Num 2) (Mul (Num 3) (Var "x")))))

; Also if we make multiplication commutative and run that run, we won't get that result either
; since the original expr has been subsumed when it was replaced with the addition
(rewrite (Mul $x y) (Mul y $x))
(run 10)
(extract $x)

; Identifiers represented as strings, keep some newtypes around to aid clarity
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"ClassT","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Class":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Class\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype ClassT (Class String))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"FieldT","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Field":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Field\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype FieldT (Field String))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"Stmt","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"New":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"New\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90},"Assign":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"Assign\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90},"Store":{"fields":["arg0","arg1","arg2"],"typst":"upright(\"Store\")({arg0}, {arg1}, {arg2})","precedence":90},"Load":{"fields":["arg0","arg1","arg2"],"typst":"upright(\"Load\")({arg0}, {arg1}, {arg2})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype Stmt
    (New String ClassT)
    ; Assign dst src
    (Assign String String)
    ; Store dst field src
    (Store String FieldT String)
    ; Load dst src field
    (Load String String FieldT))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"VarPointsTo","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"VarPointsTo":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"VarPointsTo\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}
(relation VarPointsTo (String ClassT))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"HeapPointsTo","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"HeapPointsTo":{"fields":["arg0","arg1","arg2"],"typst":"upright(\"HeapPointsTo\")({arg0}, {arg1}, {arg2})","precedence":90}}}
(relation HeapPointsTo (ClassT FieldT ClassT))

; New variables point to classes they're initialized as
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"points-to/rule-001","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","a":"a","b":"b"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_New_0_1","head/0/expr/0":"result_VarPointsTo_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= x (New a b))) ((VarPointsTo a b)))

; If I assign v1 <- v2 and v2 points to a class c2, then v1 points to class c2
; as well
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"points-to/rule-002","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","v1":"v1","v2":"v2","c2":"c2"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Assign_0_1","body/1/expr/0":"match_VarPointsTo_1_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_VarPointsTo_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= x (Assign v1 v2)) (VarPointsTo v2 c2))
      ((VarPointsTo v1 c2)))

; If c1.f points to c2, and v2 points to class c1, then assigning v1 <- v2.f
; means v1 points to c2
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"points-to/rule-003","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","v1":"v1","v2":"v2","f":"f","c1":"c1","c2":"c2"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Load_0_1","body/1/expr/0":"match_VarPointsTo_1_0","body/2/expr/0":"match_HeapPointsTo_2_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_VarPointsTo_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= x (Load v1 v2 f)) 
       (VarPointsTo v2 c1)
       (HeapPointsTo c1 f c2))
      ((VarPointsTo v1 c2)))

; If v1 points to class c1, and v2 to c2, and if v1.f <- v2, then c1.f points to
; c2
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"points-to/rule-004","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"x":"x","v1":"v1","f":"f","v2":"v2","c1":"c1","c2":"c2"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Store_0_1","body/1/expr/0":"match_VarPointsTo_1_0","body/2/expr/0":"match_VarPointsTo_2_0","head/0/expr/0":"result_HeapPointsTo_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= x (Store v1 f v2))
       (VarPointsTo v1 c1)
       (VarPointsTo v2 c2))
      ((HeapPointsTo c1 f c2)))

; Example in "From Datalog to Flix"
; l1: ClassA o1 = new ClassA();
; l2: ClassB o2 = new ClassB();
; l3: ClassB o3 = o2;

(let $l5 (Load "r" "o3" $f))

eqsat-basic-multiset:
;; Example showing how to use multisets to hold associative & commutative operations

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"Math","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"Num":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Var":{"fields":["value"],"typst":"{value}","precedence":100},"Add":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} + {right}","precedence":50},"Mul":{"fields":["left","right"],"typst":"{left} * {right}","precedence":60},"Product":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Product\")({arg0})","precedence":90},"Sum":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Sum\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype*
  (Math
    (Num i64)
    (Var String)
    (Add Math Math)
    (Mul Math Math)
    (Product MathMultiSet)
    (Sum MathMultiSet))
  (sort MathToMath (UnstableFn (Math) Math))
  (sort MathMultiSet (MultiSet Math)))

;; expr1 = 2 * (x + 3)
(let $expr1 (Mul (Num 2) (Add (Var "x") (Num 3))))
;; expr2 = 6 + 2 * x
(let $expr2 (Add (Num 6) (Mul (Num 2) (Var "x"))))

(rewrite (Add a b) (Sum (multiset-of a b)))
(rewrite (Mul a b) (Product (multiset-of a b)))

;; 0 or 1 elements sums/products also can be extracted back to numbers
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsat-basic-multiset/rule-003","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"sum":"sum","sum-inner":"sum-inner"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Sum_0_1","head/0/expr/1":"result_Num_0_1"}}}
(rule
  (
    (= sum (Sum sum-inner))
    (= 0 (multiset-length sum-inner))
  )
  ((union sum (Num 0)))
)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsat-basic-multiset/rule-004","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"sum":"sum","sum-inner":"sum-inner"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Sum_0_1"}}}
(rule
  (
    (= sum (Sum sum-inner))
    (= 1 (multiset-length sum-inner))
  )
  ((union sum (multiset-pick sum-inner)))
)

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsat-basic-multiset/rule-005","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"product":"product","product-inner":"product-inner"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Product_0_1","head/0/expr/1":"result_Num_0_1"}}}
(rule
  (
    (= product (Product product-inner))
    (= 0 (multiset-length product-inner))
  )
  ((union product (Num 1)))
)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsat-basic-multiset/rule-006","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"product":"product","product-inner":"product-inner"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Product_0_1"}}}
(rule
  (
    (= product (Product product-inner))
    (= 1 (multiset-length product-inner))
  )
  ((union product (multiset-pick product-inner)))
)

; (rewrite (Mul a (Add b c))
;          (Add (Mul a b) (Mul a c)))

; -> we would like to write it like this, but cannot (yet) bc we can't match on the inner structure of the multisets
;    and we don't support anonymous functions

; (rewrite (Product (multiset-insert a (Sum bc)))
;          (Sum (multiset-map (lambda (x) (Product (multiset-insert a x))) bc)))


;; so instead we can define a function and partially apply it to get the same function as the lambda
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"tmp-fn","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"tmp_fn":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"tmp-fn\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor tmp-fn (MathMultiSet Math) Math)
(rewrite (tmp-fn xs x) (Product (multiset-insert xs x)))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsat-basic-multiset/rule-008","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"sum":"sum","bc":"bc","product":"product","product-inner":"product-inner","a":"a"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Sum_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_Product_1_1","head/0/expr/1":"result_Sum_0_1"}}}
(rule
  (
    ;; and we can do a cross product search of all possible pairs of products/sums to find one we want
    (= sum (Sum bc))
    (= product (Product product-inner))
    (multiset-contains product-inner sum)
    (> (multiset-length product-inner) 1)
    (= a (multiset-remove product-inner sum))
  )
  (
    (union product (Sum
      (unstable-multiset-map
        (unstable-fn "tmp-fn" a)
        bc)
    ))
  )
)

; (rewrite (Add (Num a) (Num b))
;          (Num (+ a b)))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsat-basic-multiset/rule-009","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"sum":"sum","sum-inner":"sum-inner","num-a":"num-a","a":"a","without-a":"without-a","num-b":"num-b","b":"b"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Sum_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_Num_1_1","body/4/expr/1":"match_Num_4_1","head/0/expr/1":"result_Sum_0_1"}}}
(rule
  (
    (= sum (Sum sum-inner))
    (= num-a (Num a))
    (multiset-contains sum-inner num-a)
    (= without-a (multiset-remove sum-inner num-a))
    (= num-b (Num b))
    (multiset-contains without-a num-b)
  )
  (
    (union sum
     (Sum (multiset-insert (multiset-remove without-a num-b) (Num (+ a b))))
   )
  )
)

; (rewrite (Mul (Num a) (Num b))
;          (Num (* a b)))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"eqsat-basic-multiset/rule-010","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"product":"product","product-inner":"product-inner","num-a":"num-a","a":"a","without-a":"without-a","num-b":"num-b","b":"b"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_Product_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_Num_1_1","body/4/expr/1":"match_Num_4_1","head/0/expr/1":"result_Product_0_1"}}}
(rule
  (
    (= product (Product product-inner))
    (= num-a (Num a))
    (multiset-contains product-inner num-a)
    (= without-a (multiset-remove product-inner num-a))
    (= num-b (Num b))
    (multiset-contains without-a num-b)
  )
  (
    (union product
     (Product (multiset-insert (multiset-remove without-a num-b) (Num (* a b))))
   )
  )
)

(run 100)
(check (= $expr1 $expr2))

resolution:
; Resolution theorem proving
; 
; Traditional resolution theorem provers maintain a clause database
; of formulas in Conjunction Normal Form (CNF a big And of Ors).
; Each clause is a set of positive and negative literals
; The prover saturates this set by taking two clauses 
; {a}\/c1  {not a}\/c2 and creating a new clause c1 \/ c2.
; Clauses also are pruned by simplications, unit propagation,
; and subsumption.
; These systems use sophisticated term indexing to find matching clauses

; A natural question is whether egglog's saturation and term indexing gives
; a leg up towards building one of these systems. A programmable one even,
; with built in support for equality reasoning

; Resolution is provided by a join
; unit propagation is an equation solving process and egraph substitution
; Clause Simplification is provided by rewrite rules

; This encoding seems about right but is unsatisfying
; Using AC to encode the set nature of clauses is inefficient

; An important aspect of these provers that seems challenging to encode shallowly
; is that the match also occurs modulo _unification_.
; The unification variables of each clause are not globally scoped, really
; they are scoped outside the body of each clase in an implicit \forall
; This encoding as it stands really only supports ground atoms modulo equality

(datatype Bool)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"TrueConst","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"TrueConst":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"TrueConst\")","precedence":90}}}
(constructor TrueConst () Bool)
(let $True (TrueConst))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"FalseConst","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"FalseConst":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"FalseConst\")","precedence":90}}}
(constructor FalseConst () Bool)
(let $False (FalseConst))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"myor","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"myor":{"fields":["arg0","arg1"],"typst":"upright(\"myor\")({arg0}, {arg1})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor myor (Bool Bool) Bool)
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"negate","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"negate":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"negate\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor negate (Bool) Bool)

; clauses are assumed in the normal form (or a (or b (or c False)))

(union (negate $False) $True)
(union (negate $True) $False)

; "Solving" negation equations
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"resolution/rule-001","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_negate_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= (negate p) $True)) ((union p $False)))
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"resolution/rule-002","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{},"positions":{"body/0/expr/0":"match_negate_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= (negate p) $False)) ((union p $True)))

; canonicalize associtivity. "append" for clauses
; terminate with false
(rewrite (myor (myor a  b) c) (myor a (myor b c)))
; commutativity
(rewrite (myor a (myor b c)) (myor b (myor a c)))

;absorption
(rewrite (myor a (myor a b)) (myor a b))
(rewrite (myor a (myor (negate a) b)) $True)

; simplification
(rewrite (myor $False a) a)
(rewrite (myor a $False) a)
(rewrite (myor $True a) $True)
(rewrite (myor a $True) $True)

; unit propagation
; This is kind of interesting actually.
; Looks a bit like equation solving

(rewrite p $True
    :when ((= $True (myor p $False))))

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"resolution/rule-012","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_myor_0_1"}}}
(rule ((= $True (myor p $False))) ((union p $True)))

; resolution
; This counts on commutativity to bubble everything possible up to the front of the clause.
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"original_rule","id":"resolution/rule-013","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","labels":{"bindings":{"a":"a","as":"as","bs":"bs"},"positions":{"body/0/expr/1":"match_myor_0_1","body/1/expr/1":"match_myor_1_1","head/0/expr/0":"result_myor_0_0"}}}
(rule ((= $True (myor a as)) (= $True (myor (negate a) bs)))
      ((union (myor as bs) $True)))

; example predicate
; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"p","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"p":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"p\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(constructor p (i64) Bool)
(let $p0 (p 0))
(let $p1 (p 1))
(let $p2 (p 2))
;(union (or $p0 (or $p1 (or $p2 $False))) $True)
;(union (or (negate $p0) (or $p1 (or (negate $p2) $False))) $True)
(union (myor $p1 (myor (negate $p2) $False)) $True)
(union (myor $p2 (myor (negate $p0) $False)) $True)
(union (myor $p0 (myor (negate $p1) $False)) $True)
(union $p1 $False)
(union (myor (negate $p0) (myor $p1 (myor $p2 $False))) $True)
(run 10)


(check (!= $True $False))
(check (= $p0 $False))
(check (= $p2 $False))

; we could turn the original axioms into _patterns_  in all possible directions.
; Which is kind of compelling
; (rule ((or (pat x)))  )
; or let a unification expansion happen and use thos

node-limit:
; Demonstrates using (get-size!) with an :until schedule guard to cap
; how many new e-graph nodes a scheduled rewrite is allowed to add.

(ruleset node-limit-demo)

; @egg-viz-json {"schema":"egg-viz/v1","kind":"dsl_type","id":"Chain","generator":"egglog-demo-preview/v1","variants":{"SeedA":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"SeedA\")","precedence":90},"SeedB":{"fields":[],"typst":"upright(\"SeedB\")","precedence":90},"Step":{"fields":["arg0"],"typst":"upright(\"Step\")({arg0})","precedence":90}}}
(datatype Chain (SeedA) (SeedB) (Step Chain))

; Seed the e-graph with two independent chain elements so the rewrite below can fire twice as much.
(let start-a (Step (SeedA)))
(let start-b (Step (SeedB)))

; Each application of this rewrite doubles the nesting depth of `Step`.
; The schedule below uses :until to stop once the total node count hits 8.
(rewrite (Step x)
         (Step (Step x))
         :ruleset node-limit-demo)

; Run the ruleset repeatedly via saturate, exiting as soon as `(get-size!) >= 8`.
(run-schedule (saturate (run node-limit-demo :until (<= 8 (get-size!)))))

(print-size)

(check (= (get-size!) 8))
(fail (check (< (get-size!) 8)))
